title: Docs(xychart): added plotcolorpalette example
body:
## :bookmark_tabs: Summary

Added a description and an example of how to use the `plotColorPalette` to specify custom colours to the line and bar graphs. 

Documentation update was inspired by [this discussion](https://github.com/orgs/mermaid-js/discussions/5207).

## :straight_ruler: Design Decisions

No design decisions taken. This is a documentation update.

### :clipboard: Tasks

Make sure you

- [x] :book: have read the [contribution guidelines](https://mermaid.js.org/community/contributing.html)
- [ ] :computer: have added necessary unit/e2e tests.
- [x] :notebook: have added documentation. Make sure [`MERMAID_RELEASE_VERSION`](https://mermaid.js.org/community/contributing.html#update-documentation) is used for all new features.
- [ ] :butterfly: If your PR makes a change that should be noted in one or more packages' changelogs, generate a changeset by running `pnpm changeset` and following the prompts. Changesets that add features should be `minor` and those that fix bugs should be `patch`. Please prefix changeset messages with `feat:`, `fix:`, or `chore:`.
